context: Yumiko and Sho do morning chores.
purpose: Casual home register; vocabulary (ゴミ/袋/育児/体重/階段) in natural home.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 正坊、ゴミを袋にまとめてくれる?
lines.en: Sho, can you gather the trash in the bag?
lines.style: gentle mother voice, soft warm caring delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん!この袋、いっぱいだね。
lines.style: cheerful small child voice, bright warm bouncing delivery throughout

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 階段の下まで、運んでくれる?
lines.en: Can you carry it to the bottom of the stairs?
lines.style: gentle mother voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: It's heavy, but I can do it!
lines.style: determined small child voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ありがとう。体重、増えてきたね。
lines.style: warm mother voice, soft warm affectionate delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 大きくなった証拠だよ!
lines.style: proud small child voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 育児って、毎日が運動みたいね。
lines.en: Childcare is like exercise every day.
lines.style: gentle mother voice, soft warm amused delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 階段、駆け上がって戻るね!
lines.en: I'll race up the stairs and back!
lines.style: energetic small child voice, bright warm cheerful closing delivery throughout
